statement: A successful authoritative system-table repair records per-table observation evidence even when the authoritative result is unchanged or empty; snapshot freshness consumes the newest mutation-or-authoritative-observation watermark without conflating observation with mutation, so an unchanged service_endpoints table cannot remain permanently cache_stale_watermark after a successful repair, and the unchanged production five-node MovieLens Wave-4 milestone completes successfully.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Before changing runtime source, reproduce the live composition with the real authoritative-repair gateway, system-table cache, and preflight freshness consumer: service_endpoints has an old or absent mutation watermark, a successful authoritative read returns an unchanged or confirmed-empty row set, and the repaired snapshot must become fresh without fabricating a CDC mutation. Prove red-on-revert.

Represent per-table authoritative observation time and cause as explicit cache data distinct from last mutation time. The authoritative-reconcile owner records it only after a successful complete read/reconcile, and freshness consumers select from that evidence rather than independently inferring freshness from repair promises, row counts, or elapsed mutation age.

Add a focused TLA+ model of mutation watermark age, authoritative unchanged/empty observation, observation-watermark publication, freshness classification, repair retry, and schema admission. A mutation-only freshness mutant must violate eventual admission after successful authoritative observation while the fixed data-owned model passes; do not claim exhaustive repository layer coverage.

Do not relabel an authoritative observation as a CDC mutation, advance schema/version watermarks without source evidence, accept failed or partial reads as fresh, weaken tombstone/causal ordering, or allow an unconfirmed empty read to authorize deletion or freshness. Preserve existing cache mutation timestamps and cause IDs.

Use report movielens-lagrange-service-affinity-live-2026-07-16T12-23-19-124Z.report.json and immutable archive wave4-live-operation-ledger-terminal-hold-2026-07-16T12-23-19-124Z.tar.gz as the pre-fix witness: totalSpreadGap was 0 and authoritative readiness repairs succeeded, but schema admission remained observation_unavailable/stale_usable with cache_stale_watermark until the unchanged 180000ms budget expired.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.
